ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from moving an Opportunity to Closed Won unless both the SOW and Budget SharePoint folder URLs are populated. This rule only triggers when Stage is changed to Closed Won.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), OR( ISBLANK(SOW_SharePoint_Folder__c), ISBLANK(Budget_SharePoint_Folder__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please add both the SOW and Budget SharePoint folder links before marking this Opportunity as Closed Won.
